name: A1 document-aware menus, A2 toolbar, E1 shell honesty and A3 docks
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project, then every application menu with the schematic and then the PCB as the active document (Phase 1 A1: menus come from the action registry and change with the document). Then the A2 toolbar: icon buttons, the grid/unit/snap combos of each editor (unit and grid size changed through their View menu entries, which write the same per-editor store as the combos; snap toggled by an XTest click on its check box), a split-button dropdown whose pick becomes the main button, and View > Toolbar labels. Then E1 (dead-control sweep): removed placeholders are absent from the toolbar and menus, the Saved badge reports the engine state, the menu bar moves with the arrow keys, the status bar shows a copper layer only in the PCB editor, View > Show <view> shows (twice stays shown), Help lists the generated shortcuts and About shows the version (both close on Escape), and the Library tab says the distributor is not configured. Then A3: the three docks of the PCB workspace (design manager left, Layers in the right dock, canvas strip), real pointer moves updating the strip's X/Y, an XTest drag resizing the right dock and its hide button, the schematic keeping its own dock layout, a part placed from the Library tab of the bottom dock and selected from the design manager's Components list, and after a webview reload the PCB's hidden right dock and its dragged width restored (spec UI-01).
